    Coverings of polarized right translation quivers #

    This file connects Mathlib's star-and-costar notion of a quiver covering to the polarized right-mesh data used by the magnitude formalization. A mesh cover preserves projective vertices, translation, and the polarization. Its star bijections transport local finiteness and identify every lifted mesh with the corresponding mesh downstairs.
